# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.0 Route 2: O(1) Native-Style Top-Bar Alerts Strip. Generated by gen_top_alerts.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Ultra-lightweight human-player-only monthly scalar cache refresher for top-bar alerts.
# Rebel-guarded per fx17; skips all AI countries (0 AI overhead) so GUI top-bar checks remain strictly O(1).
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_top_alerts_monthly_pulse } }

oe_top_alerts_monthly_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        is_subject = no
    }
    effect = {
        # Cache 1: Praetorian Prefecture / Classical Diocese slot available (BYZ/ROM)
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = yes
                exists = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org
                has_variable = oe_prf_done_1
                OR = {
                    AND = {
                        oe_prf_has_eligible_unorganized_dio = yes
                        oe_prf_auth >= 5
                        gold >= 100
                    }
                    AND = { oe_prf_pref_1_eligible = yes NOT = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2 } }
                    AND = { oe_prf_pref_2_eligible = yes NOT = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 2 } }
                    AND = { oe_prf_pref_3_eligible = yes NOT = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 2 } }
                    AND = { oe_prf_pref_4_eligible = yes NOT = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 2 } }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_alert_cache_prf_avail value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_alert_cache_prf_avail value = 0 }
        }

        # Cache 2: Pre-150-location low-loyalty Theme/Exarchate snapshot fallback for human BYZ/ROM
        # (When Empire Entropy is active, oe_ent_recalc_cache refreshes oe_ent_cache_low_loy in Slot 65.)
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = yes
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_index }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_low_loy value = oe_ent_low_loyal_themes }
        }

        # Cache 3: Maritime Silk Corridor charter / monsoon convoy decision ready
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_sea_participant = yes
                OR = {
                    AND = {
                        current_year >= 1380
                        gold >= 200
                        stability >= 0
                        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sea_dec_calicut_done } NOT = { var:oe_sea_dec_calicut_done = 1 } }
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:kozhikode
                            owns = location:goa
                            oe_sea_roman_company_active = yes
                            oe_sea_yuan_shibosi_active = yes
                        }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        current_year >= 1385
                        gold >= 180
                        stability >= 0
                        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sea_dec_sonargaon_done } NOT = { var:oe_sea_dec_sonargaon_done = 1 } }
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:sonargaon
                            owns = location:gaur
                            oe_sea_roman_company_active = yes
                            oe_sea_yuan_shibosi_active = yes
                        }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        current_year >= 1395
                        gold >= 220
                        stability >= 0
                        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sea_dec_malacca_done } NOT = { var:oe_sea_dec_malacca_done = 1 } }
                        OR = {
                            owns = location:malacca
                            owns = location:trowulan
                            owns = location:palembang
                            owns = location:ayodhya
                            tag = MLC
                            tag = MAJ
                            tag = AYU
                        }
                    }
                    AND = {
                        current_year >= 1410
                        gold >= 160
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_sea_convoy_cd }
                        has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level
                        trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_sea_corridor_level } global_var:oe_sea_corridor_level >= 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_alert_cache_sea_ready value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_alert_cache_sea_ready value = 0 }
        }

        # Cache 4: Far Seas Overseas Factoria envoy / Atlantic waystation decision ready
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_far_roman_host = yes
                OR = {
                    AND = {
                        oe_far_east_open = yes
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_envoy_east_cd }
                        OR = {
                            oe_far_any_east_envoy = yes
                            oe_far_any_east_lease = yes
                        }
                        gold >= oe_far_cost_east_press
                    }
                    AND = {
                        oe_far_west_open = yes
                        modifier:can_colonize = yes
                        NOT = { has_variable = oe_far_envoy_west_cd }
                        gold >= oe_far_cost_1m
                    }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_alert_cache_far_ready value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_alert_cache_far_ready value = 0 }
        }
    }
}
